================================================================================
Cleaned clearRAM3 corpus preserves the local ambiguous terminator association
================================================================================
clearRAM3 macro startaddr,endaddr
	if startaddr>endaddr
	elseif startaddr=endaddr
		warning "clearRAM is clearing zero bytes. Turning this into a nop instead."
		exitm
	endif
	if ((startaddr)&$8000)=0
		lea     (startaddr).l,a1
	else
		lea     (startaddr).w,a1
	endif
		moveq   #0,d0
	if ((startaddr)&1)
		move.b  d0,(a1)+
	endif

.clear
	rept 16
		move.l  d0,(a1)+
	endr
		dbf     d1,.clear
		move.w  d0,(a1)+
	endif
		move.b  d0,(a1)+
	endif
	endm
